lines.en: This note is too big. How can Mia invite Leo to play?
lines.zh: 纸条过不去。米娅怎么邀请对面的里奥来玩？

lines.en: They share a code. Gold is one. Blue is zero.
lines.zh: 约好一张表。金色是一，蓝色是零。

lines.en: Yes! His screen says PLAY. The invitation got through!
lines.zh: 可以！邀请送到了。一起玩吧！

en.spoken: Yes! His screen says play. The invitation got through!

lines.en: A gift is hidden in one of ten boxes.
lines.zh: 礼物藏在十个箱子里。里奥要找出来。

lines.en: Four yes-or-no answers lead him to box seven.
lines.zh: 四个回答，七号箱找到了！

lines.en: Watermelon! Now it's Leo's turn to send a message.
lines.zh: 是西瓜！这回，轮到里奥回信。

lines.en: Leo presses Send. A gold signal carries his reply: got it!
lines.zh: 他按下发送键，一颗金色小球传了回去：收到啦！

lines.en: Our tiny pipe connects two friends.
lines.zh: 两个朋友，就用小管子传话。

lines.en: Videos, messages, even chats with AI—all use zeros and ones.
lines.zh: 视频、消息、AI聊天，全都用零和一。

en.spoken: Videos, messages, even chats with AI, all use zeros and ones.
en.instruction: Please speak warmly and clearly, with natural connected speech. Say AI smoothly as the familiar two-letter name, without a long gap. Keep the story light and curious.

zh.spoken: 视频、消息、人工智能聊天，全都用零和一。

lines.en: A funny story? A new game? What will you share today?
lines.zh: 一个好玩的故事？一个新游戏？今天你想分享什么？

en.instruction: Ask each question slowly, playfully, and clearly, like chatting with a child. Pause for half a second after story and after game. Keep the last question warm and inviting.

zh.instruction: 像和孩子聊天一样，轻快、俏皮地问这三个小问题。短句清楚亲切，问题之间自然稍停。
